name: AWS Lambda — Functions
description: Pull Lambda functions as serverless cloud workloads for CNAPP inventory and posture analysis

steps.instruction: Log into the AWS Management Console and go to IAM → Users
Create or select an IAM user and attach the AWSLambda_ReadOnlyAccess managed policy
Go to Security credentials → Create access key → Choose 'Third-party service'
Specify the AWS region to scan

validation_request.error_message: Could not connect to AWS Lambda. Verify your access key has AWSLambda_ReadOnlyAccess permission and the region is correct.

transform.expr: {'cloud_provider': 'aws', 'service': 'lambda', 'function_name': record.get('FunctionName', ''), 'arn': record.get('FunctionArn', ''), 'account_id': (str(record.get('FunctionArn', '')).split(':')[4] if record.get('FunctionArn') and len(str(record.get('FunctionArn', '')).split(':')) > 4 else ''), 'region': (str(record.get('FunctionArn', '')).split(':')[3] if record.get('FunctionArn') and len(str(record.get('FunctionArn', '')).split(':')) > 3 else '')}

{'cloud_provider': 'aws', 'resource_type': 'lambda_function', 'runtime': record.get('Runtime', ''), 'role': record.get('Role', ''), 'handler': record.get('Handler', ''), 'code_size': record.get('CodeSize', 0), 'memory_size': record.get('MemorySize', 0), 'timeout': record.get('Timeout', 0), 'last_modified': record.get('LastModified', ''), 'version': record.get('Version', ''), 'architectures': record.get('Architectures', []), 'package_type': record.get('PackageType', ''), 'state': record.get('State', ''), 'environment_variables': list((record.get('Environment', {}) or {}).get('Variables', {}).keys()) if record.get('Environment') else [], 'vpc_config': record.get('VpcConfig', {}), 'kms_key_arn': record.get('KMSKeyArn', '')}

region.description: AWS region to scan for Lambda functions (e.g. us-east-1, eu-west-1)
